property_summary: For any admissible input, a Command(adr, "") call with msg.value = v delivers exactly v wei to adr (adr's balance rises by exactly v); the mutant instead forwards the contract's entire balance, so adr receives the wrong amount whenever c's balance differs from v.
change_summary: Replace msg.value with address(this).balance in the external call so the contract's entire balance is forwarded instead of the sent value.
